prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1419; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was seen for neck and upper back complaints consistent with whiplash-type soft tissue injury. The reported mechanism of injury is in keeping with the pattern of symptoms described at intake. Over the course of 28 visits, care proceeded along a conventional path, beginning with a period of more frequent sessions focused on pain control, range-of-motion work, and graded strengthening. Visit frequency reduced steadily as symptoms improved and the patient regained function. Examination findings included reduced cervical range of motion and localized tenderness in the paraspinal muscles, which support the diagnosis. Some other orthopedic and neurological screening tests were within normal limits. The patient also has a history of treatment to the same region within the past two years, and that prior condition contributes to some of the current symptoms and limitations. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.
